<fidel-amharic-keyboard>

Amharic keyboard. Type Amharic with no Amharic keyboard installed: choose the consonant, then its form.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Refugees and learners on shared or borrowed computers with no Amharic keyboard, and anyone who cannot remember the key combinations.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<label for="answer">Your answer</label>
<textarea id="answer" lang="am"></textarea>
<fidel-amharic-keyboard for="answer"></fidel-amharic-keyboard>

Source: player/src/components/d/amharic-keyboard.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-amharic-keyboard>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
forid of an <input>, <textarea>, <fidel-input> or <fidel-textarea>noneThe field to type into.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

None. The field's own input event fires, so your listeners and validation see each letter.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Show Amharic keyboard" opens it. The letters are one Tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move between them; Enter or Space chooses.
  • Choose ለ, then ሉ: the letter goes in at the cursor. Escape in step 2 goes back. "Delete one letter" and "Back to the text" are buttons.
  • Each consonant button is also named in Latin letters, e.g. "ለ, le".

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English. The letters are marked lang="am".

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.1.1 Keyboard: One Tab stop, arrow keys, Home and End, Enter or Space, Escape.
  • 3.1.2 Language of Parts: Ethiopic letters carry lang="am"; each name adds a Latin reading.
  • 1.4.10 Reflow: The letter grid wraps at 320 px.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
